node.title: WCL (4,10) even-weight divisor descent
node.statement: Let char K = 0 or > 10, omega of exact order 2048, and let a reduced signed weight-10 relation satisfy the ell=4 window p_1=p_3=p_5=p_7=0. Since gcd(10,2048)=2 the global dilation used at (4,9) and (4,11) does NOT exist -- but the even case needs no normalisation at all. Newton gives e_1=e_3=e_5=e_7=0; the odd indices at most 10 are {1,3,5,7,9}, so e_9 survives and e_10 = prod rho is free. Hence F(X) = E(X^2) - e_9 X with E(T)=T^5+e_2T^4+e_4T^3+e_6T^2+e_8T+e_10 monic quintic -- the single odd term sits INSIDE the even part, unlike the odd cells where X sits outside. e_9 != 0 is AUTOMATIC: e_9 = 0 makes F even, so roots fall into antipodal pairs, which reducedness forbids. Squaring E(rho^2) = e_9 rho gives the square locator G(Y) = E(Y)^2 - e_9^2 Y, monic of degree 10, equal to prod (Y - rho_i^2) and dividing Y^1024 - 1, with reconstruction rho = E(y)/e_9. The elimination endpoint is ten relations in six unknowns. OWED: the Delta certificate, subject to the same feasibility caveat as (4,9)/(4,11).
node.attack_surface: The Delta certificate: show the ideal (R_0..R_9) in Z[e_2,e_4,e_6,e_8,e_9,e_10] has no characteristic-zero point and extract Delta. Symbolic Y^1024 mod G blows up, so prefer the clean symmetric-function form recorded on the (4,9) node.
node.falsifier: A monic quintic E and nonzero e_9 over an admissible field with G = E(Y)^2 - e_9^2 Y dividing Y^1024-1 whose reconstruction yields a genuine reduced weight-10 relation satisfying the ell=4 window -- i.e. a live (4,10) vanisher.
node.notes: Minted 2026-07-27. The parity dichotomy flagged (4,10) as obstructed (gcd(10,2048)=2) and predicted it would need a sub-tuple router in the style of the closed (2,5)/(2,6). The resolution is simpler: even weights need no dilation at all, because the window conditions alone deliver the normal form and e_9 != 0 comes free from reducedness. Subtraction check clean at b13de811.
